home.title: AdagioX · School management software, in development
home.meta.description: School management software in development: secure sign-in, granular permissions, an audit trail, timetables with conflict detection, families and pickup control.
home.status.badge: In development: not yet available to schools
home.hero.title: School management where every school’s data stays its own
home.hero.lead: AdagioX is a multi-school platform for secure sign-in, granular permissions, an audit trail, timetables and family records. Everything shown below already exists in the product; what is still to come is listed at the end of the page.
home.carousel.label: Product screens
home.carousel.hint: Scroll sideways or use the arrow keys to browse the screens. They show a test school with fictional data.
home.carousel.cap.hero-schedule: Weekly timetable of a class group, with subject, teacher and room in every slot.
home.carousel.cap.schedule-conflict: Moving a lesson is refused when the teacher already has a lesson at that time.
home.carousel.cap.role-permissions: Role editor: each permission is allowed, denied or left undefined, with its scope.
home.carousel.cap.audit-log: Audit log of who did what and when, with filters and export.
home.carousel.cap.family-unit: Family unit linking guardians and students, with relationship and access level.
home.carousel.cap.pickup-door: Front-desk search before a child is handed over to an authorised person.
home.carousel.cap.school-branding: Each school sets its own logo, favicon and sign-in background.
home.carousel.cap.sign-in: The sign-in page shows the school’s own name and logo.
home.features.title: What already works
home.features.intro: Each block below describes functionality that is implemented today. Screens show a test school with fictional data.
home.s.access.title: Secure access, with several ways to sign in
home.s.access.text: People sign in with a local account or through an external identity provider. A second factor protects the account, and every user can review and close their own active sessions.
home.s.access.i2: Two-factor authentication by authenticator app or email, which a role can make mandatory
home.s.access.i3: Single sign-on with an external provider, through OIDC or SAML 2.0
home.s.access.i4: List of active sessions, with remote sign-out
home.s.tenant.title: Several schools on one platform, each with its own brand
home.s.tenant.text: The data of each school is isolated from every other school. Each school presents the platform with its own identity and enables only the modules it needs.
home.s.tenant.i2: Own logo, favicon and sign-in background
home.s.tenant.i4: User invitations and bulk user import
home.s.roles.title: Roles and permissions, down to the scope
home.s.roles.text: A permission combines a resource, an action and a scope, and anything not granted is denied. School administrators create their own roles in an editor and check the effective permissions of any user.
home.s.roles.i1: Custom roles alongside the default ones
home.s.roles.i2: Each permission is allowed, denied or left undefined
home.s.roles.i3: When a user has several roles, a denial prevails over an allowance
home.s.audit.title: An audit trail of who did what
home.s.audit.text: Creations, changes and deletions are recorded with the user, the moment and the record affected. Administrators search the log and export it when they need to.
home.s.audit.i1: Filters by date, operation, user, module and entity
home.s.timetable.title: Timetables that refuse conflicts
home.s.timetable.text: Each class group has a weekly timetable with the subject, teacher and room of every slot. A change that would put a teacher in two places at once is refused, and spaces can be booked.
home.s.timetable.i1: Teacher conflicts detected before a change is saved
home.s.timetable.i2: Booking of rooms and other spaces
home.s.timetable.i3: A weekly view for each class group
home.s.families.title: Families, guardians and who may do what
home.s.families.text: Students and their guardians are grouped into family units. Each link records the relationship, legal representation and level of access, so access can be restricted for one student without affecting the rest of the family.
home.s.families.i1: Guardians and students in a family unit
home.s.families.i3: Consent for the use of images recorded with the family
home.s.pickup.title: A controlled hand-over at the front desk
home.s.pickup.text: Staff look up a student and see who is authorised to collect them before the child leaves. The authorised persons are managed for each student.
home.s.pickup.i2: Authorised pickup persons recorded for each student
home.also.title: And also
home.also.academic.title: Academic structure
home.also.academic.text: Lets a school define its courses and groups, its academic periods and its grading scales.
home.also.year.title: Academic year lifecycle
home.also.year.text: Lets a school open, close and reopen an academic year, and open the next one starting from the previous.
home.also.languages.title: Four interface languages
home.also.languages.text: The interface is available in Spanish, English, German and French, and each user picks their own.
home.next.title: Coming next
home.next.text: These parts of the first phase are not built yet. They are listed without dates and in no promised order.
home.next.i5: Portals for families, teachers and students
home.built.title: How it is built
home.built.text: AdagioX is developed with Claude Code.
home.contact.title: Contact
home.contact.text: AdagioX is not yet available to schools. If you are evaluating the project, write to us.

legal.body.privacy.controller.text: El responsable es el titular indicado arriba, Andrés Matías López, con quien puede contactar en founders@adagiox.com.
legal.body.privacy.data.title: Datos tratados
legal.body.privacy.data.text: Este sitio no tiene formularios ni cuentas. El proveedor de alojamiento recibe y registra la dirección IP y los datos técnicos de cada petición (fecha y hora, página solicitada y navegador). Si escribe a founders@adagiox.com, se tratan su dirección de correo, su nombre si lo indica y el contenido del mensaje, datos que usted mismo facilita al escribir. No se toman decisiones automatizadas ni se elaboran perfiles.
legal.body.privacy.purpose.title: Finalidad
legal.body.privacy.purpose.text: Servir las páginas del sitio, garantizar su seguridad y su funcionamiento, y responder a los mensajes que se reciban por correo electrónico.
legal.body.privacy.basis.title: Base jurídica
legal.body.privacy.basis.text: Interés legítimo del responsable en mantener la seguridad y el funcionamiento del sitio y en atender las comunicaciones que recibe (art. 6.1.f del RGPD).
legal.body.privacy.processor.title: Encargado del tratamiento
legal.body.privacy.processor.text: El sitio se aloja en Cloudflare, Inc. y el correo electrónico lo presta Arsys Internet, S.L.U. Ambos actúan como encargados del tratamiento en virtud de sus acuerdos de encargo del tratamiento.
legal.body.privacy.transfer.title: Transferencias internacionales
legal.body.privacy.transfer.text: Cloudflare, Inc. tiene su sede en Estados Unidos. La transferencia se ampara en la Decisión de Ejecución (UE) 2023/1795 de la Comisión, relativa al Marco de Privacidad de Datos UE-EE. UU., en el que Cloudflare, Inc. está certificada (art. 45 del RGPD), y, en su defecto, en las cláusulas contractuales tipo de la Decisión de Ejecución (UE) 2021/914 (art. 46.2.c del RGPD), incorporadas a su acuerdo de encargo del tratamiento. Arsys Internet, S.L.U. tiene su sede en España.
legal.body.privacy.retention.title: Plazo de conservación
legal.body.privacy.retention.text: Los datos técnicos de las peticiones se conservan durante el plazo que fija el proveedor de alojamiento, actualmente de al menos 31 días en sus registros de análisis de tráfico; después se suprimen o se agregan de forma anónima según su política de conservación. Los mensajes de correo se conservan mientras sea necesario para atender la comunicación y después se suprimen, salvo que deban conservarse por una obligación legal.
legal.body.privacy.rights.title: Derechos
legal.body.privacy.rights.text: Puede ejercer sus derechos de acceso, rectificación, supresión, oposición, limitación del tratamiento y portabilidad escribiendo a founders@adagiox.com. Cuando el tratamiento se basa en el interés legítimo, puede oponerse a él en cualquier momento por motivos relacionados con su situación particular (art. 21 del RGPD). Si considera que el tratamiento no se ajusta a la normativa, puede presentar una reclamación ante la Agencia Española de Protección de Datos (www.aepd.es).
legal.body.privacy.cookies.title: Cookies y recursos de terceros
legal.body.privacy.cookies.text: Este sitio no usa cookies ni tecnologías de seguimiento, no usa analítica y no carga recursos de terceros (fuentes, scripts ni imágenes).

img.hero-schedule.alt: Wochenstundenplan einer Klasse von Montag bis Freitag, in dem jede Stunde mit Fach, Lehrkraft und Raum belegt ist.
img.schedule-conflict.alt: Wochenstundenplan einer Klasse, bei dem das Verschieben einer Stunde auf einen anderen Zeitpunkt mit dem Hinweis abgelehnt wird, dass die Lehrkraft zu dieser Zeit bereits Unterricht hat.
img.role-permissions.alt: Berechtigungseditor für eine benutzerdefinierte Rolle im Modul Schulverwaltung, in dem jede Berechtigung mit ihrem Geltungsbereich erlaubt, ausdrücklich verweigert oder nicht erteilt ist.
img.audit-log.alt: Prüfprotokoll mit Angaben, wer wann was in der Schule getan hat, etwa Änderungen an Stundenplaneinträgen, Schülerinnen und Schülern, Räumen und Rollenberechtigungen, mit Filtern nach Datum, Vorgang, Benutzer, Modul und Entität sowie Exportfunktion.

img.pickup-door.alt: Pförtnerbildschirm, auf dem das Personal eine Schülerin oder einen Schüler nach Namen sucht, bevor das Kind an eine berechtigte Person übergeben wird.
img.school-branding.alt: Einstellungen zur Markenidentität der Schule mit Logo, Favicon und Anmeldehintergrund, jeweils mit Formaten und Größenbeschränkungen.
img.sign-in.alt: Anmeldeseite einer Schule mit eigenem Namen, Logo und eigenen Farben über den Feldern für E-Mail-Adresse und Passwort.
